site_evidence.note: The landing page's <head> could not be read on 2026-11-08: the W3C Nu HTML Checker raised 337 errors on the homepage (270 style rules outside @scope in a <style> element in body, plus 4 <style> placement errors); 279 errors on /contact-us/ validator errors and the message list filled the whole report, so the source section - and with it the title, meta description, Open Graph tags, structured data and any pixel - was never returned. ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
ads_audit.account_only: M02 Conversions API, M03 event deduplication, M04 Event Match Quality, M06 aggregated measurement, M07 standard vs custom events, M08 CAPI Gateway, M09/M-AT1 attribution windows, M10 data freshness, M13/M14 learning phase, M15/M16 campaign & ad-set structure, M17 budget distribution, M36 bid strategy, M37 frequency caps, M38 breakdown reporting, M40 A/B testing, M19-M24 audiences & first-party data
